title: Calico balls, admission prices and dance band size
summary: Calico balls, 25-cent admission, and ten-man bands usually without drums or piano.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Can you ask him what a hoop drill was?
What a hoop drill was? What was a hoop drill? You know when you drill? They call it a hoop drill. I guess there was some jumping in the business. I'm jumping a bit in the family.
I knew nothing but... You know nothing but... What was a calico ball? A calico ball.
That was clothes. The clothes they wore. That cheap material. You know, dress material. Calico.
And they had calico balls. Uh huh.
They'd all go dressed up like that.
Oh, everyone had their way to... Calico.
Didn't cost them much to go any place.
And ask him how much it cost to get in the places.
How much they used to charge to go in those dances? It was 25, huh? 25 cents.
25 cents. When he played those dances, what kind of a band? How big a band?
How big the band was when y'all played those dances? You used 10 men or 12 men?
10, 12. Mostly 10. They didn't use no drums.
It must have been years ago, Calico. I used to hear them talk about that.
They didn't use drums on the dances?
They didn't use no drums? Huh? They didn't use drum player?
Not all the time.
Not all the time.
Did they use a piano? They said, well, 10 men use this as good.
They used a piano in there? Huh? Did they have a piano player? A fellow that played piano? Y'all didn't use any piano? No.
No.
They used a bass, I guess. That's what it must have been.
